title: Complex nominalizations
summary: Take apart and build the dense clauses of written Turkish: clauses inside clauses, verbal nouns with a case and a postposition (`-mAsIndAn dolayı`, `-mAsInIn ardından`), clauses that label a noun (`-DIğI gerçeği`, `-mAsI ihtimali`), `-mAzlIk`, and the suffixes behind much of the scientific vocabulary.
canDo: Unpack a sentence with one clause inside another, and build one
Link events in formal writing with -mAsIndAn dolayı, -mAsInIn ardından and -mAsI sonucunda
Name a fact, a claim or a possibility with a whole clause: -DIğI gerçeği, -mAsI ihtimali
Recognize -mAzlIk and the suffixes behind words like ölçüm, bilimsel and meslektaş
